build_linear_segmentation_model: build a LinearSeg model with a pretrained encoder and classification head for semantic segmentation
create_encoder_with_pretrained_weights: create an encoder from pixio module and load pretrained checkpoint weights for feature extraction
freeze_encoder_parameters: freeze all encoder parameters by setting requires_grad to False for linear probing
extract_patch_and_cls_features: extract and concatenate normalized patch tokens with averaged class tokens from encoder output
upsample_segmentation_output: upsample the segmentation logits to original image size using bilinear interpolation
